inputs: scope: institution id, state code, canonical_fee_key or national
optional labelled answer key (with its tuning or holdout set)
outputs: accuracy table: right / amount not supported / category not supported / unknown, dollar and rate fees apart
miss list with severity from deming/severity.ts
budget: deterministic, no paid calls; one read-only sample query plus stored texts for the sample
triggering_workflows: accuracy question from James or a thread
before and after a Knox, Darwin or Hamilton rule version bump
failure_behavior: Report the counts it has and mark the rest unknown; give no accuracy percentage when the decided sample is under 30 fees or the database cannot be read.
approval_requirements: None to run (read-only). Any fix it points to goes through a normal PR; takedowns stay with Hamilton's second look.
abstain_when: fewer than 30 sampled fees have stored text
frequency or payer accuracy is asked and no labelled key covers the fees
rate and dollar fees would have to be pooled into one number
